features.title: Volume Bundle
features.howItWorks: Set tiers like Buy 5 / 10 / 15, each with its own discount. The shopper picks a tier, chooses variants to fill the pack, and the total + savings update live before adding to cart.
features.benefits: Lift average order value with quantity breaks that reward bigger carts — ideal for wholesale, multipacks, and stock-up staples — while you keep full control over every tier and discount.
features.flexibility: Show tiers as a compact list or cards, on the product page or a dedicated bundle page, in portrait or horizontal layouts — all styled to match your theme.

features.title: Cross-Sell Bundle
features.howItWorks: Group products that sell well together and apply a bundle discount — customers add the whole set in a single click.
features.benefits: Increase AOV by pairing complementary products at a bundled price — a proven upsell that turns one purchase into a complete set without extra clicks.
features.flexibility: Curate the exact set, fix or expose quantities, and let shoppers choose variants — shown right on the product page or as a 'frequently bought together' block.

features.title: Mix & Match — Single Product
features.howItWorks: Pick a product, choose the pack sizes, and shoppers assemble their own mix with the discount applied as the box fills.
features.benefits: Boost engagement and AOV by letting shoppers build their own pack from one product's variants — perfect for colour packs, sample sets, and subscription-style boxes.
features.flexibility: Set pack sizes and tiered pricing, cap quantities per variant, and display it as a compact grid or a full page — portrait or horizontal to fit any theme.

features.title: Mix & Match — Multiple Products
features.howItWorks: Curate the products, set min/max and per-variant limits, and customers build a personalized multi-product bundle.
features.benefits: Grow basket size with fully customizable multi-product sets — great for curated collections and custom kits — while you keep control over rules and limits.
features.flexibility: Curate the catalog, set min/max and per-variant limits, and offer variant options inline — as an embedded widget or a standalone bundle page.

features.title: Build Your Own Box
features.howItWorks: Design a guided, multi-step flow — choose a box, add items, and collect custom details before adding to cart.
features.benefits: Turn gifting into a premium experience that lifts AOV — shoppers assemble a personalized box, add a card, and leave a message, all in one guided flow.
features.flexibility: Configure each step — boxes, products, cards, and custom form fields — then reorder or drop steps to fit any gifting or subscription flow.
